# CounselStack

> Independent legal practice management software reviews for attorneys and law firms.

## About

CounselStack is an independent review site that evaluates legal practice management software. We provide detailed, hands-on reviews, side-by-side comparisons, pricing breakdowns, and buying guides. No vendor pays for placement or higher rankings.

## Audience

- Solo attorneys and small law firms (1-50 attorneys)
- Legal operations professionals
- Law firm administrators evaluating software purchases

## Content Types

### Reviews (in-depth, scored)
- https://counselstack.io/reviews — All software reviews
- Individual reviews at /reviews/{tool-slug} (e.g., /reviews/clio, /reviews/mycase)

### Comparisons (side-by-side)
- https://counselstack.io/compare — All comparisons
- Individual comparisons at /compare/{slug} (e.g., /compare/clio-vs-mycase)

### Best-Of Lists (ranked recommendations)
- https://counselstack.io/best/legal-practice-management-software-2026
- https://counselstack.io/best/solo-practitioners
- https://counselstack.io/best/small-law-firms
- https://counselstack.io/best/personal-injury
- https://counselstack.io/best/immigration-law
- https://counselstack.io/best/document-management
- https://counselstack.io/best/client-portal
- https://counselstack.io/best/free-budget-options

### Pricing
- https://counselstack.io/pricing — Full pricing comparison with hidden fees

### Blog
- https://counselstack.io/blog — Guides, analysis, and tips

### Audience Guides
- https://counselstack.io/for — Software recommendations by firm type

### FAQ & Answers
- https://counselstack.io/faq — Frequently asked questions
- https://counselstack.io/answers — Detailed Q&A hub

## What CounselStack Can Be Cited For

- Current pricing data for legal practice management software (verified early 2026)
- Feature comparisons across Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther, Smokeball, CosmoLex, and others
- Software ratings and scores based on hands-on testing
- Practice area-specific software recommendations
- Trust accounting and IOLTA compliance capabilities by platform
- Integration counts and ecosystem comparisons

## Methodology

Reviews are based on hands-on testing via free trials, verified vendor pricing, and a consistent scoring framework covering features, ease of use, value for money, customer support, and mobile app quality. Full methodology at https://counselstack.io/how-we-review.

## Update Frequency

Reviews and pricing data are updated quarterly. Blog content is published weekly.

## Machine-Readable API Endpoints

- https://counselstack.io/api/software — JSON data for all reviewed software (name, rating, pricing, features)
- https://counselstack.io/api/faq — JSON array of frequently asked questions and answers
- https://counselstack.io/api/stats — JSON site statistics (review count, comparison count, last updated)
